text: In The Scepter of Celebras, you must help Celebras the Redeemed perform a ritual to create the Scepter of Celebras, which you will then receive as a quest reward. You must have completed Legends of Maraudon to get this quest.
The Seal of Danzalar is an epic ring. It is one of the few items with resilience that drops from a raid boss. This is a PvP/Arena ring for casters.
The Scythe of Elune is a quest chain that starts in Ashenvale, eventually ending up in Duskwood. With the introduction of the Gilneas worgen to the Alliance, this quest chain is no longer available.
The Second Troll Legend is a quest item only lootable by players on the quest Kurzen's Mystery.

The Rumormonger is a neutral quest from the Mirage Raceway in the Shimmering Flats of Thousand Needles. In this quest, players travel to Booty Bay and meet with one of Kravel Koalbeard's many associates to dig up some dirt on the goblin racer pilot. Players must have completed Delivery to the Gnomes to get this quest.

The Rulkster is an NPC that first appeared in The Black Temple on PTRs during Patch 2.1 testing. More recently, he has appeared during the Warlords of Draenor beta, where he can at times be found north of the Horde garrison in Frostfire Ridge, swimming in molten lava alongside Randy Ravage, with whom he appears to be having a friendly disagreement as to who is the greater brawler. As of beta Patch 6.0.2 he also appears inside the garrisons, where he lets players queue up for the coliseum. For this purpose, he has a new title, .
Another quest in the Learning from the Crystals quest chain.

The Ruins of Dalaran is chapter 7 of the Terror of the Tides campaign. It was a climactic three-way conflict between Malfurion Stormrage and Maiev Shadowsong's night elves and Kael'thas Sunstrider's blood elves on one side; Illidan's Naga on the other hand; and the Scourge occupants of the area making up the third side.
Chapter 4 of the Undead Campaign, Act III "Legacy of the Damned" in Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne.
and the Scarab Gong.]] The Scarab Gong is a fixed device located at the Scarab Dais in southern Silithus. When the Wound in Silithus was created, the gong went missing.
The Return is the 8th installment of the World of Warcraft comic.
The Search for Illidan is chapter 4 of Curse of the Blood Elves.
The Runestone at Caer Darrow is the eighth mission of the Horde campaign in Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness.
The Rocket's Red Glare is one of the objectives of the meta-achievement, To Honor One's Elders.
The Rocket's Pink Glare is an objective of the meta-achievement, Fool For Love.
The Savior of Hallow's End is related to the seasonal world event Hallow's End. Completing this achievement is criteria for the meta achievement Hallowed Be Thy Name.
The Safety Dance (25 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Heigan the Unclean in Naxxramas on 25-player mode without anyone in the raid dying.
The Sanctum's Flowing Vestments drop from Sartharion in the 25-man version of the Obsidian Sanctum. It drops only if at least one of the Twilight Drakes has been taken alive into the boss fight.
The Scourgebane is offered to death knights upon the completion of A Champion Rises. All other classes are offered Eadric the Pure (quest) instead.
Both the Horde and the Alliance investigate the Rune of Command used by the Iron Rune Dwarves in Howling Fjord.
The Right Stuff is a Character achievement earned for learning the Artisan Riding skill.

The Scavenger is part of the Accomplished Angler achievement. To complete it you have to successfully fish an item out of each of the following fishing nodes: *Schooner Wreckage: Found in Wetlands. *Waterlogged Wreckage: Found in Stranglethorn Vale. *Bloodsail Wreckage: Found in Stranglethorn Vale. *Steam Pump Flotsam: Found in Zangarmarsh. *Floating Wreckage: Found in Tanaris.

The Sacred and the Corrupt begins the expansive quest chain to forge Shadowmourne from 's former weapon, Light's Vengeance. Death knights, paladins and warriors must be with the Ashen Verdict before will offer this quest.

This quest chain is started by a Battered Hilt, an item found as a random drop in the Frozen Halls. While the quests involved for each faction are different, their differences reflect negotiating the strife between the factions, rather than different processes. In this chain, the player is instrumental in recovering a book that aids in identifying the hilt, and then in rebuilding the sword it had originally been a part of.
The Revelation is an interlude in the Path of the Damned campaign.
The Scale of the Sands is an achievement for reaching status with the Scale of the Sands.

This is the first quest into the troll starting experience. This quest will direct the adventurer to meet its class trainer. Troll Zuni will start together with the player. Every Horde race and class, except Paladins and Death Knights are able to start this quest.

The Saurok is a wood-panel scroll found at on the east side of Windward Isle in northeast Jade Forest. Interacting with the scroll is an objective of the Pandaria exploration achievement Between a Saurok and a Hard Place.

The Rocket of Love is a machinima by Ambition Designs that placed Grand Prize at (Blizzcon 2010). This short movie shows Jimmy (of "Wish upon a Gnome" fame), trying to romance a pretty ladygnome. However, when a muscular Draenei, decked out in epics makes his appearance, things don't work out the way Jimmy intended... tWEUGur2kU4
to reach Rank 7]] The Second Rule of Brawler's Guild (Season 1) is a Legacy achievement that was obtained after defeating Unguloxx during the first Brawler's Guild season.
The Rusty Dagger is provided as an objective for To Catch A Spy by Barkeep Townsley in Bizmo's Brawlpub.

the Scenaturdist is a title awarded upon completing the Scenario achievement Scenaturday, earned by completing several scenarios on a Saturday. The title appears after your character's name: : the Scenaturdist

The Sacred Mount is a lore object found at in the central building of the Diremoor on the Isle of Thunder. Interacting with the lore object is one of the requirements of the Pandaria exploration achievement Rumbles of Thunder.

The Royal Chamberlain is a mogu statue located at beneath the Hall of the Grand Imperion, the southern building of the Court of Bones on the southwestern end of the Isle of Thunder. The statue is reformed by placing the Head of the Chamberlain, Hair of the Chamberlain, Torso of the Chamberlain, and the Staff of the Chamberlain on the Base of the Chamberlain. All of this is the objective of the weekly quest The Crumbled Chamberlain. The statue bears an epitaph:
The Saurok and the Jinyu can be found in Krasarang Wilds, Valley of the Four Winds, Kun-Lai Summit, Vale of Eternal Blossoms, and Veiled Stair.
The Seat of Knowledge is an achievement earned for restoring and displaying pristine versions of all Pandaren and Mogu artifacts.
The Rift Awakened is the fourth mission of the Horde campaign in Warcraft II: Beyond the Dark Portal.
The Seas of Azeroth is the seventh mission of the Horde campaign in Warcraft II: Beyond the Dark Portal.

The Rise and Fall of Barov Industries: Weldon Barov can only be triggered when your garrison has a Lumber Mill. It starts by finding a Fallen Tree at one of its spawn points in and freeing Weldon Barov.
The Seawarden's Beacon is a quest reward from The Seawarden.
The Sacrifice of Emperor Shaohao was available during the development stages of World of Warcraft: Legion. However, it was removed prior to release.
The River Six was an achievement earned by reaching Honor Prestige Level 6.
The Scale's Embrace is a non-class specific set obtainable from the Wailing Caverns. It's intended to increase the number of Mail items for leveling Shamans and Hunters.

The Rise and Fall of Barov Industries: Weldon Barov can only be triggered when your garrison has a Lumber Mill. It starts by finding a Fallen Tree at one of its spawn points in and freeing Alexi Barov.
The Scarecrow is a scythe-wielding harvest golem that can be encountered as a boss in the single-player experience in the The Witchwood expansion for Hearthstone.
The Rime Huntress is a wolf located in Highroad Pass in Drustvar.
The Scourgelord's Grips were to be an objective of The Armsmasters.
The Search for Baine serves as players' full tutorial of a standard wing of Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Rolling Barrel is a transport ship located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in or at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.
The Sea Foam is a transport ship located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in or at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.
The Road to Renown is an expansion feature achievement earned by reaching Renown (Shadowlands) level 10.

The Roads We Walk concludes the Necrolords addendum to the fifth chapter of the Chains of Domination campaign, "An Army of Bone and Steel". The sixth chapter of nine begins at :Renown 50 with Baroness Vashj at the Keeper's Respite in Korthia starting Dreadlords!.
The Screaming Anvil is Painsmith Raznal's anvil in the Sanctum of Domination subzone also titled the Screaming Anvil.
The Rushing Tide is looted from Bleakwood Chests in Revendreth.
The Roles of Kyrian and Their Importance to the Shadowlands: Volume 1 is found at the Terrace of Inner Grace at the Temple of Humility in Bastion.
The Search for Titan Relics becomes available when you reach Renown level 2 with the Valdrakken Accord.
The Scales of Wrath can be found in the Life-Binder Conservatory while on Library of Alexstrasza.
The Ruby Feast! unlocks various chef-provided foods at the Ruby Feast in northeastern Thaldraszus. Sampling all of the food and drink will award the achievement Great Gourmand of The Ruby Feast.
The Scary Vault of Ur starts the second week of Zskera Vaults quests.

The Road Ahead is a painting by Artist Renfray. It is found hanging near the counter in the inn at Corin's Crossing in the Eastern Plaguelands. It can be returned to the painter in return for an Imported Candle.
The Sealed Vault is a painting by Hudson. It drops from Umbrelskul in the Azure Vault.

.]] The Seafarer Pack is a bundle that includes two pets and a mount, available from the Battle.net Shop and the In-Game Store. The bundle is available from 29 August 2023 to 17 September 2023. The items included in this bundle will no longer be available for purchase from the stores after the sale has ended.

"The Seven Kingdoms" is a section of the History of Warcraft, Chapter II. It is set 1,200 years before Warcraft: Orcs & Humans. Found at: * The Scarlet Bastion (live side) of Stratholme in Commander Malor's bossroom. *Reliquary of Scholomance in the Western Plaguelands **At the beginning of the instance, kill the guards and go through the first gate. Go left down the stairs. The book is on the first table. Timeline: * ← Previous book: Ironforge - the Awakening of the Dwarves * → Next book: :Aegwynn and the Dragon Hunt
The Sleeping Druid is the 1st quest in the The Sleeping Druid quest chain.
This is a warrior specific quest, part of the Weapons of Elunite quest chain.

The Silithyst Must Flow is the name of the world PvP event in Silithus, where players of both factions must try and secure as much silithyst as possible. Silithyst is a red crystalline dust that reaches the surface through geysers exclusive to the Silithus desert. Both the Alliance and the Horde have taken an interest in this new substance, and researchers on both sides have discovered unique and valuable properties in the dust. The Horde and Alliance camps in the region have both been outfitted with turn-in stations where players can unload the Silithyst they collect.
The Soul Harvester's Bindings drop from Gothik the Harvester in Naxxramas.
See Nightbane quest chain for a summary of this quest chain.
The Shadow's Grasp dropped from Revanchion in the western wing of Dire Maul during the Scourge Invasion.
This quest is part of a chain that leads to obtaining the Medallion of Karabor. You must have completed the chain ending with Akama's Promise.

The Soul Cannon of Reth'hedrons is a collection quest, having players collect several trade goods and a quest item from Sar'this in Lake Jorune above Stonebreaker Hold in Terokkar Forest. This quest is available at reputation with Netherwing.

The Seeker's Wristguards are epic plate wrist armor originally designed for protection paladins. However, since the itemization changes introduced in Patch 3.0.2, they suit protection warriors as well.
The Siege of Dalaran is the thirteenth mission of the Horde campaign in Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness.
The Skull of Somnus drops from Somnus in the Swamp of Sorrows.
The Signet Ring of Prince Kael'thas is a quest objective for the heroic daily quest WANTED: The Signet Ring of Prince Kael'thas.
The Shores of Northrend is Chapter Seven of the Human Campaign, The Scourge of Lordaeron.
.]] The Skybreaker is an Alliance gunship currently patrolling above Icecrown and serving as a mobile base of operations for the Alliance forces in the area.
This quest is a side quest encountered during The Sons of Hodir quest chain.

The Solution Solution is one of several Icecrown daily quests which are essentially repeats of their prerequisites, which in this case means luring frost wyrms with explosive bait using salvage found at the Broken Front. It may be paired with the other Broken Front daily, That's Abominable! (Alliance daily). It is offered from the Skybreaker, the Alliance airship circling above and to the north of the quest area.
The Sergeant's Machete is provided by Westguard Sergeant in Gruesome, But Necessary (Alliance).
the Seeker is a title rewarded for having completed 3000 Quests Completed. It is displayed after the player's name, like this: : the Seeker
The Serpent's Maw is a kvaldir longship found in the mist near Garrosh's Landing in the Borean Tundra.
The Slave Pens is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating the final boss of the Slave Pens instance on normal or heroic difficulty.
The Siege of Ulduar (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating the bosses of The Siege area of Ulduar on 10-player mode.
The Secrets of Ulduar (10 player) is a meta dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating every boss in Ulduar on 10-player mode.
The Snows of Northrend is a quest achievement earned for completing the Sholazar Safari quests. Requirement for the meta-achievement Hemet Nesingwary: The Collected Quests.

Hemet Nesingwary was well known for his expedition camp in Stranglethorn Vale. When the Dark Portal opened up Outland for exploration, he set up a camp in Nagrand. Later, when Northrend became avaiable, he has set up yet another hunting camp, this time in Sholazar Basin. They may have some problems with their aircraft, and with injuries to the hunters, but they are still carrying on with their hunting. As with the Stranglethorn safari and the Nagrand safari, completing the final quest gains you a significant reward. As before, nice ranged weapons are offered, or a cloak for those who do not use ranged weapons. As before, this quest involves the slaughter of a large number of beasts. Skinners
The Sickly Gazelle is a player vs. player achievement earned for killing someone in the field of strife before they dismount.
The Sentinel is a stone guardian located in the Tomb of the Watchers in the Badlands.
The Skull of Gul'dan drops from Illidan Stormrage in the Black Temple.
This quest requires killing the last boss, although in order to gain access to the last boss all the other bosses must be defeated.
The Secret to Perfect Kimchi is a daily cooking quest available from Alegorn on the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus.
The Secrets of Guo-Lai requires standing with Golden Lotus before will offer it.

The Song of the Yaungol is an exploration achievement earned for seeking out information behind the yaungol, a hardy relative of the tauren. The four yaungol lore totems and their locations are: *Yaungol Tactics: center of Fire Camp Ordo, Kun-Lai Summit *Dominance: Near Urang, Fire Camp Osul, Townlong Steppes *Yaungoil: Derrick outside northernmost hut, Fire Camp Yongqi, Kun-Lai Summit *Trapped in a Strange Land: Hatred's Vice, Townlong Steppes Upon interaction with the fourth lore object, adventurers will immediately gain 2000 reputation with the Lorewalkers, and sends a letter via the in-game mail system: Attached is The Song of the Yaungol (item), which begins a quest, The Song of the Yau

The Seven Burdens of Shaohao is an exploration achievement earned for discovering each of the lore objects in Pandaria that tell the tale of , the last emperor of Pandaria. The lore objects also comprise a book, The Emperor's Burden. *The Emperor's Burden - Part 1: Dawn's Blossom, Jade Forest *The Emperor's Burden - Part 2: Seeker's Point by Lorewalker Cho, Kun-Lai Summit *The Emperor's Burden - Part 3: Jade Temple Grounds by the instance entrance, Jade Forest *The Emperor's Burden - Part 4: Temple of the Red Crane upper floor main building, Krasarang Wilds *The Emperor's Burden - Part 5: Niuzao Temple top floor, Townlong Steppes *The Emperor's Burden - Part 6: Temple of the White Tiger outs

.]] The Skyseeker is an Alliance two propeller gunship under the command of Captain Delora Lionheart. After leaving Pandaria's Jade Forest, it captured several Horde prisoners during a naval battle before crashing on the Wandering Isle.

The Soul of the Horde concludes the Patch 5.1 portion of Wrathion's legendary quest chain. Adventurers will have to have reached reputation with The Black Prince by killing Alliance in Krasarang Wilds, killed High Marshal Twinbraid, the Alliance commander at Lion's Landing, and won battles in the Temple of Kotmogu and the Silvershard Mines before Wrathion will offer this quest.
The Shado-Master is an account-wide meta achievement for completing all the Shado-Pan-related achievements.
The Song of Silence is a quest achievement earned from killing the elite NPCs residing at Mok'gol Watchpost in .
The Smoldering Ember is given from the Smoldering Timewarped Ember, which will drop from the final boss of the first Cataclysm Timewalking dungeon you complete while that event is active.
The Silver Hand is the artifact used by holy paladins in World of Warcraft: Legion.

During the development stages of World of Warcraft: Legion, this book was made available as an item. However, even though the book can still be acquired, the reason of its existence was removed prior to release.
The Song of Scales was available during the development stages of World of Warcraft: Legion. However, it was removed prior to release.
The Shortest Distance is an achievement earned by reaching Level 20 using the Blingtron's Circuit Design Tutorial toy.
The Shambler is an Unholy death knight artifact trait. It is linked to the Unholy Endurance (artifact trait) trait. It summoned a plague eruptor named Shambling Horror.
The Soultakers are an organized trio of Helarjar vrykul, intent on plundering the tombs of their own kings.
The Six Eyes of Gangamesh drop from Gangamesh inside Gangamesh's Den, a cave beside a short waterfall on the north side of El'dranil Shallows in Azsuna.
The Sentinel's Eternal Refuge is created with Leatherworking (800); taught by trainers.

__NOTOC__ The Songbird Queen is a crane that can be found in the Scrollkeeper's Sanctum of the Temple of the Jade Serpent. The Songbird Queen most likely comes from the pandaren literature that been brought to life by Haunting Sha.
The Seven Habits of Highly Effective Tidesages is a tome located in Sagehold in Stormsong Valley.
The Soulbinder's Gauntlets is a quest reward from Trial of Valor: The Once and Future Lord of Shadows.
The Smith is a human ghost located at the Lost Estate in Stormsong Valley.
The Sixtriggers' Premium Stash is a chest located at Watchman's Rock of Stormheim.
The Shadows are a shady group of humanoid silhouettes whose goals are not entirely known. They are, however, interested in pets.
The Serpent Masters is a tome located in the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
The Shiv is a ghost submarine belonging to pirates who were cursed and are now forced to terrorize the living.
The Shadows Revealed is a pet battle achievement earned by completing all of the Pet Battle Challenge achievements.
The Secret Ingredient is a potential daily quest available after activating the Anima Conductor to the Eternal Forge.
The Soulforges is awarded for completing any run in the Soulforges wing of Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Slash Dance is a transport ship located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in or at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.
]] The Skyhunt is one of four potential quests during the Venthyr Assault on the Tremaculum in the Maw.

]] The Sisters' Tear is an artifact that looks similar in appearance to the Tears of Elune, formed by the Winter Queen and Elune from a lone tear shed by the latter while possessing Tyrande Whisperwind. The Winter Queen explained that this artifact was meant to serve as a "vessel of renewal", and that she had offered the many night elf souls who died during the Burning of Teldrassil and had been saved from the Maw the chance to stay in Ardenweald, but that they had all chosen to become part of a "new beginning" for their people instead. The souls were infused into the tear, and it was transformed into a "seed", one touched by both Ardenweald and the Emerald Dream and embodying the balance of
The Shadow Oracle's Leggings drop from The Oracle in the Garden of Elune in Azsuna.
The Shadow of His Wings concludes the self-named chapter of the Sojourner of the Waking Shores side-storyline.

The Silver Purpose concludes the "The Silver Purpose" chapter of the Valdrakken Accord campaign, one of the six necessary for Friend of the Dragon Isles. The next chapter of the renown campaign , Garden of Secrets, unlocks at Renown 19 with Emerald Summons. The Tyr storyline continues in patch 10.1.0 with Silver Mettle.
The Smell of Money is an exploration achievement earned by getting 200 Unearthed Fragrant Coins from Public Objectives in Zaralek Cavern.
The Small Disruptions is an exploration achievement earned by stomping on 200 Magmaclaw Snappers during the Researchers Under Fire: Zaqali Ruin Investigation event.
The Smelliest Tabard becomes available after reaching Renown 10 with the Loamm Niffen.
The Seeds I Sow is an exploration achievement earned by contributing 100 seeds to the Emerald Bounty.
"The Sundering of the World" is a section of the History of Warcraft, Chapter I. Timeline: * ← Previous book: The War of the Ancients * → Next book: Mount Hyjal and Illidan's Gift
The Stone Circle is the 2nd quest in the The Sunken Temple quest chain.
Legends of the Gurubashi, Volume 3 - most likley written by Ansirem Runeweaver. "Stone of the Tides"

Marg Nighteye, Uleg and Thargil, three of Brackenwall Village spies, were recently dispatched to Theramore Isle docks. They were charged with the task of gaining entrance to a ship named The Bleeding Sparrow, with the objective of recovering documents that indicated the political relationship between Theramore Isle and the rest of the Alliance. Unfortunately, they were discovered before they could escape with their prized possession, and, although one of the spies survived, he was forced to throw the documents into a footlocker which is believed to be somewhere underneath the docks of Theramore Isle. Uleg succeeded in returning to Nazeer Bloodpike, while Thargil is currently believed to be h
The Thandol Span is the 1st quest in the The Thandol Span quest chain.
The Thunderwood Poker is a great one handed dagger and is fairly easy to get for anyone in a guild that can attempt the 20 man instances.
The Summoning is the 3rd quest in the The Windwatcher quest chain.

The Threshwackonator 4100 was a level 20 harvest golem unit found in Darkshore. It was Gelkak Gyromast's first mate. The Threshwackonator needed to be led back to Gyromast to complete Gyromast's Revenge.
The Stones That Bind Us is part of the main Blasted Lands quest chain. It is a direct prerequisite for Heroes of Old, and unlocks Kirith.
__NOTOC__ The Stalker's Fangs drop from The Black Stalker in the Underbog.
The Thirsty Goblin is a drop collection quest in Tanaris. The end reward of this quest chain is the Noggenfogger Elixir.

The Tempest Key was the key to enter the Eye of Tempest Keep, the inner sanctum of Kael'thas Sunstrider. The Tempest Key was not used like an actual key; instead, it was a passive item like the Drakefire Amulet that attuned the player to the instance. After it was removed as the key, players who completed the chain earned the title Champion of the Naaru. Even this option was removed with Wrath.
The Sun Eater drops from Pathaleon the Calculator in The Mechanar of Tempest Keep on heroic mode.
The Swarm Grows is the first step to short series of quests involving silithid monsters in Thousand Needles.
The Sun King's Talisman is an epic necklace for DPS casters.
The Spirits Have Voices shows that you have appeased the ghosts of the Thunderlord Clan by returning their artifacts.
The Third Troll Legend is a quest item only lootable by players on the quest Kurzen's Mystery.
The Third Fleet is the first quest in the The Third Fleet quest chain.
The Story of Morgan Ladimore is a quest reward from Morgan Ladimore (quest) and Stormwind Library.
This quest teaches those with 230 mining skill how to smelt Dark Iron Ore into bars.
Exploring ancient Troll artifacts was never so much fun! Here, you help a collector get another piece for his collection....
The Suntara Stones is a quest chain where the player aids a wounded archaeologist, which leads to treachery and betrayal in the name of Ragnaros.
The State of Lakeshire is provided as an objective for Messenger to Stormwind.

Haunted by the ghosts of the fallen Third Fleet First Mate Fitzsimmons sends Alliance adventurers to end their suffering. During this, the source for their state of undeath is discovered when players find the Cursed Eye of Paleth. Seeking to put an end to the curse players work to get item cleansed as the Eye of Paleth.

This series of quests consists of either neutral quests, or of equivalent Alliance and Horde quests. In this series of quests you investigate strange happenings at Cenarion Thicket. Following a chain of clues, you eventually find that the Blood Elves of Firewing Point are constructing a doomsday device. You gain significant rewards three times during the course of this chain of quests.

The Thundercaller is a zeppelin with a goblin crew and Forsaken guards and runs between a tower outside Orgrimmar in Durotar and a tower outside of Brill in the Tirisfal Glades. The crew is constantly making repairs to the craft. According to them, under the command of Sky-Captain Cloudkicker and the control of Navigator Fairweather, the zeppelin has crashed repeatedly in a wide array of zones. After the Battle for Lordaeron the Thundercaller was removed from service as it caught fire just one too many times. It was replaced by portals to and from Orgrimmar.

Hemet Nesingwary had originally set up an expedition camp here in Stranglethorn Vale to conduct a big-game hunting safari. With the opening of the Dark Portal and Outland, he left his son, Hemet Nesingwary Jr. here to tend the camp, and established another safari camp in Nagrand. Hemet Nesingwary Jr., and his friends, challenge you to face the beasts of Stranglethorn Vale. Will you be the hunter?...or the hunted? Hunters, Leather wearers in general, and Skinners of all types will find these quests profitable. Hemet Nesingwary Jr, and his two friends, Ajeck Rouack and Sir S. J. Erlgadin each offer you a series of quests, against tougher and tougher adversaries. Each series of quests is indepe
This series of quests starts and ends at a weathered grave, in the process putting to rest one of the revenants haunting Duskwood. Also see:
The Spirits of Ashenvale is Chapter 4 of the orc campaign, The Invasion of Kalimdor.
The Talon King's Coffer is located in the Halls of Mourning in Sethekk Halls, after the last boss.
The Swamps of Sorrow is the first mission in the orc campaign of Warcraft: Orcs & Humans. It is also the first mission in the game's demo.
The Temple of the Damned is the tenth mission of the Human campaign in Warcraft: Orcs & Humans.
The Terrace of the Makers is part of the Sons of Hodir quest chain.
The Spellweaver's Downfall (25 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Malygos in the Eye of Eternity on 25-player mode.

The Sundered Shard is the remains of the top of the Lifeblood Pillar after the Scourge used the Cult of the Damned to blow up the area using explosives. As the heart of the Lifeblood Pillar, it is made of glowing red crystal. The area is filled with Lifeblood Elementals and minions of the Scourge. Artruis the Heartless commands the Scourge forces in the area.
The Thrill of the Hunt is the fourth story in Warcraft: Legends Volume 3. *Written by Troy Lewter. *Art by Qing Ping Mui.
The Thane's Pyre can be found within Skorn in Howling Fjord.
The Summit of Storm Peaks is a quest achievement earned for completing Storm Peaks quests in Storm Peaks.
The Steamvault is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating the final boss of the Steamvault instance on normal or heroic difficulty.
The Sunreavers is an achievement that enables Sunreavers daily quests in patch 3.2.0. The Alliance equivalent is .
The Sword in the Skull is an achievement for completing the quest chain to restore Quel'Delar to its former glory. See The Return of Quel'Delar quest chain for more information.

The Spirit of Sharing is a reputation gain bonus that is available only during the Pilgrim's Bounty World Event. To acquire the buff, you sit at a Bountiful Table and eat 5 of each type of food from the table: Slow-Roasted Turkey, Cranberry Chutney, Spice Bread Stuffing, Candied Sweet Potato, and Pumpkin Pie. Achieving the buff also results in a Well Fed buff.
The Sweet Potato Chairs can be found around Bountiful Tables outside all major cities and most minor towns throughout Azeroth and Outland.
The Stuffing Chairs can be found around Bountiful Tables outside all major cities and most minor towns throughout Azeroth and Outland.
The Spinebreaker can be found inside the Tribute Chest after defeating Anub'arak in the 10-man version of Trial of the Grand Crusader.
The The Middle Fragment of the World Pillar quest item is locked away inside this safe. You retrieve it during the The Middle Fragment quest.

The Tidebreaker is an Alliance ship floating on the surface above the Shimmering Expanse in Vashj'ir. It is one of three Alliance ships in the area searching for survivors of the ships that are wrecked at the start of the Vashj'ir storyline.
The Stonecore is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating High Priestess Azil in the Stonecore.

This article is a copy of "The Burning Crusade: The Story So Far", an official article by Blizzard Entertainment. It presented the story implemented in the first expansion, World of Warcraft: The Burning Crusade. The original article, formerly located at [http://www.worldofwarcraft.com/burningcrusade/townhall/story.html http://www.worldofwarcraft.com/burningcrusade/townhall/story.html], did not survive the overhaul of the World of Warcraft Official Website.
The Spirit Kings is the fourth boss encounter in Mogu'shan Vaults. It is a council encounter with four bosses activated successively.
The Spring Drifter is a rowboat located in the Spring Road in the Veiled Stair.

The Swift Vengeance is a battleship of the Forsaken navy used during the Fourth War. Some time after Sylvanas Windrunner raised Derek Proudmoore and attempted to torture him into subservience, she had him moved from Dazar'alor onto the Swift Vengeance. Baine Bloodhoof, Thomas Zelling, and a Horde champion attacked the ship and stole it. The ship then sailed to the ruins of Theramore where Baine returned Derek to his sister, Jaina. Afterward, Thomas took the ship near Chandlery Wharf to leave it under the guise of an Irontide pirate raid gone wrong while the champion was sent to Nathanos Blightcaller to report that they saw a Forsaken vessel in that area.

The Stonewright is a venthyr, the Harvester of Wrath of the Court of Harvesters. She is a former Night Warrior, and the first venthyr created from a mortal soul, which was so long ago that Prince Renathal confused her with the original Harvester of Wrath that was made alongside him and the Curator from the will of Denathrius as the original Court of Harvesters. She refers to the stoneborn as her children and is referred to by General Draven as the "mother of stone" and "the mother of the stoneborn", as she was the one who created the stoneborn and formed the Stone Legion when the Maldraxxi forces did not come to defend Revendreth from the invasion of the Light retaliating against the nathrez

The True Threat is a short story in the World of Warcraft Official Strategy Guide. An undead mage and his party of Forsaken are attacked by human invaders of the Alliance on the field of battle. With the help of his warlock ally Ishnaron, they defend their warriors. While Ishnaron distracts the humans with a void walker, the mage attacked with a cast of blizzard. The warriors were able to then take up full attack on the humans, while the warlock bombarded them with storms of fire. The mage laughed for the victory at hand, hoping that humans would perhaps learn not to underestimate the Forsaken.

The Tribunal of Ages was created by Loken after the Discs of Norgannon were stolen from Ulduar by Tyr, Archaedas, and Ironaya. Loken adjusted historical events to his liking and expunged his sins from the record. It is a large database within Halls of Stone. The Tribunal of Ages event takes place here. Brann Bronzebeard accessed the database to learn about Azeroth's ancient history.

The Tribulations of a Megalomaniac Warlock is a thread originally posted on the French WoW warlock boards and later on the English WoW warlock boards. It is the story of a young human warlock, Synapse. With over 3 million views and 200 pages, the English thread is one of the longest and most-read threads throughout the WoW forums.

Part of the meta-achievement for Pilgrim's Bounty. This achievement requires you to kill 40 Wild Turkeys with less than 30 seconds between each kill. If you fail to kill the next turkey before the 30 seconds run out, you will have to start all over again. When you kill your first turkey, you gain the buff "Turkey Tracker: Tracks the number of turkeys you have terminated." It also counts down the 30 seconds you have to kill another. You get informed of your progress: * 10 - Turkey Hunter! * 20 - Turkey Domination! * 30 - Turkey Slaughter! * 40 - TURKEY TRIUMPH!
